title: CRM Dashboard: convert all widgets to provider:'object' dynamic data with full aggregate diversity
body:
All CRM dashboard charts and the table used static `provider: 'value'` with hardcoded items, meaning the `provider: 'object'` → `ObjectChart` → `aggregateRecords()` data path was untested except for a single widget (Revenue by Account, which rendered blank). This converts the entire dashboard to dynamic data with full aggregate function diversity and cross-object coverage. ### Dashboard config (`crm.dashboard.ts`) 12 widgets total: 4 KPI metrics (static), 7 charts (dynamic aggregation), 1 table (dynamic fetch). - **Revenue Trends** (area): `sum(expected_revenue)` grouped by `stage` - **Lead Source** (donut): `count` grouped by `lead_source` - **Pipeline by Stage** (bar): `sum(amount)` grouped by `stage` - **Top Products** (bar): `sum(price)` grouped by `category` (product object) - **Recent Opportunities** (table): dynamic fetch from `opportunity` object - **Revenue by Account** (bar): already `provider: 'object'`, unchanged - **Avg Deal Size by Stage** (line): `avg(amount)` grouped by `stage` - **Orders by Status** (bar): `max(amount)` grouped by `status` (order object — cross-object) ```ts // Before — static, never exercises the data pipeline data: { provider: 'value' as const, items: [{ stage: 'Prospecting', amount: 250000 }, ...] } // After — hits ObjectChart → dataSource.find() → aggregateRecords() data: { provider: 'object' as const, object: 'opportunity', aggregate: { field: 'amount', function: 'sum' as const, groupBy: 'stage' } } ``` Also fixed `accessorKey: 'date'` → `'close_date'` on the table to match the actual opportunity field. ### Aggregate function diversity All four aggregate functions are exercised across the dashboard: **sum**, **count**, **avg**, **max**. ### Cross-object coverage Widgets reference three different objects: `opportunity`, `product`, and `order`. ### i18n Added `avgDealSizeByStage` and `ordersByStatus` widget labels across all 10 locales (en, zh, ja, ko, de, fr, es, pt, ru, ar). ### Tests **CRM metadata tests** (`crm-metadata.test.ts`) — 9 new assertions: - All chart/table widgets use `provider: 'object'` with valid aggregate configs - `aggregate.groupBy` ↔ `categoryField` and `aggregate.field` ↔ `valueField` alignment - Aggregate function diversity coverage (sum, count, avg, max) - Cross-object widget validation (order) **DashboardRenderer rendering tests** (`DashboardRenderer.widgetData.test.tsx`) — 6 new tests: - Area chart with `provider: 'object'` sum aggregate → `object-chart` schema - Donut chart with `provider: 'object'` count aggregate → `object-chart` schema - Line chart with `provider: 'object'` avg aggregate → `object-chart` schema - Cross-object bar chart (order) with `provider: 'object'` max aggregate → `object-chart` schema - Empty widgets array edge case - Null data config edge case ### ROADMAP Added completed item for full `provider: 'object'` adaptation.
Original prompt > > ---- > > *This section details on the original issue you should resolve* > > [全链路动态数据] CRM Dashboard Metrics/Charts/Table provider: 'object' 全面适配+空白BUG跟踪 > # 问题总览 > > **当前 ObjectUI CRM Demo 的 Dashboard 动态数据适配存在以下系列问题和高优建议，现合并成一条全链路 issue 跟踪：** > > --- > ## 1. Charts/Table/KPI "全部空白" 与 provider: 'object' 动态数据不渲染 > - 实际 demo 环境打开主看板，Recent Opportunities 可以正常渲染，但所有下方 Metrics 和 Charts 区域无论数据量如何都显示空白（详见 [截图](image2)）。 > - 该空白和聚合字段、对象 mock 驱动等有关，已排除表字段名、series dataKey、yField等初级配置问题。 > - pipeline: 聚合/对象 provider 路径没有走通，真实业务环境全部动态 provider: 'object' 场景未被覆盖。 > > --- > ## 2. 代码与配置现状复盘 > - 相关文件：examples/crm/src/dashboards/crm.dashboard.ts > - 仅最后一项 Revenue by Account 走 provider: 'object'，其余全部走静态 mock items，导致大部分场景无法暴露数据适配/渲染类 bug。 > - 数据提供层 opportunity.data.ts 已包含 7 条 mock 数据、account 字段为 lookup-id（未做自动解引用）。 > - ObjectChart/AggregateRecords/DashboardRenderer 代码层面实际已实现聚合与 series 字段自动适配。 > - 但 demo config 未做到全面动态化，测试 surface 严重不足。 > > --- > ## 3. 综合建议与方案 > - **将整体 examples/crm/src/dashboards/crm.dashboard.ts 所有 metrics/charts/table 全部统一切换为 provider: 'object' 构造，流程如下：** > - 所有 chart/table/widget 均以 data: { provider: 'object', object, aggregate } 配置，聚合字段覆盖 amount、expected_revenue、stage、account、source、product、order 等全量字段。 > - 涉及 groupBy、count、sum、avg/min/max 等不同类型。 > - 新增跨对象、join/lookup、时间与动态区间、筛选等更复杂 provider: 'object' 场景。 > - **补充自动化回归测试，强依赖 provider: 'object' 路径，静态数据仅留最小对照组**。 > - 【重要】Mock 数据结构和 lookup 解引用、聚合算子、空数组/null/异常分支都要联动测试。 > - 每次变更必须附带 test（如 examples/crm/__tests__/DashboardRenderer.widgetData.test.tsx）。 > > --- > ## 4. 目标和验收标准 > - Dashboard/KPI/Charts 全部动态渲染、任何对象 provider 都可正常出现在看板视图，bug 能被自动发现。 > - RM/release/roadmap 更新、全量测试须通过。 > > --- > 相关截图： > > > --- > 相关历史： > - objectstack-ai/objectui#835 Revenue By Account 图表空白及聚合字段问题 > - objectstack-ai/objectui#836 PR初步修复 extractRecords/字段适配，但无法终结全部空白 bug > - 本议题合并所有上述细节与建议，总结为唯一主线，供维护者/贡献者 review/推进。 > > /cc @objectstack-ai/objectui-maintainers > > Copilot is powered by AI, so mistakes are possible.
